python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Data from treasury bulletins (in millions of dollars)
# FY 2010-2014 from 2015 bulletin, FY 2015-2019 from 2020 bulletin, FY 2020-2024 from 2025 bulletin
fiscal_years = [2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]
receipts = [2161728, 2302495, 2449092, 2773979, 3020847, 3248722, 3266689, 3314893, 3328745, 3462195, 3419955, 4045980, 4896119, 4439283, 4918737]
outlays = [3455931, 3598086, 3538447, 3454254, 3504199, 3687623, 3854101, 3980720, 4107741, 4446583, 6551871, 6818159, 6271508, 6134433, 6751553]

print("FY | Receipts (M) | Outlays (M) | Actual Balance (M)")
print("-" * 60)
for i, fy in enumerate(fiscal_years):
    actual_balance = receipts[i] - outlays[i]
    print(f"{fy} | {receipts[i]:,} | {outlays[i]:,} | {actual_balance:,}")

# Apply Hodrick-Prescott filter with lambda = 100
def hp_filter(y, lamb=100):
    """
    Apply Hodrick-Prescott filter to a time series.
    lamb: smoothing parameter (100 for annual data as per standard practice)
    """
    n = len(y)
    # Create the second difference matrix
    D = np.zeros((n-2, n))
    for i in range(n-2):
        D[i, i] = 1
        D[i, i+1] = -2
        D[i, i+2] = 1
    
    # Calculate trend: (I + lamb*D'D)^-1 * y
    I = np.eye(n)
    trend = np.linalg.solve(I + lamb * D.T @ D, y)
    
    return trend

# Convert to numpy arrays
receipts_arr = np.array(receipts, dtype=float)
outlays_arr = np.array(outlays, dtype=float)

# Apply HP filter with lambda = 100
trend_receipts = hp_filter(receipts_arr, lamb=100)
trend_outlays = hp_filter(outlays_arr, lamb=100)

# Calculate structural and actual balances
structural_balance = trend_receipts - trend_outlays
actual_balance = receipts_arr - outlays_arr

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("After HP Filter (lambda=100):")
print("=" * 80)
print("FY | Receipts (M) | Trend R (M) | Outlays (M) | Trend O (M) | Actual Bal (M) | Structural Bal (M)")
print("-" * 120)
for i, fy in enumerate(fiscal_years):
    print(f"{fy} | {receipts_arr[i]:,.0f} | {trend_receipts[i]:,.0f} | {outlays_arr[i]:,.0f} | {trend_outlays[i]:,.0f} | {actual_balance[i]:,.0f} | {structural_balance[i]:,.0f}")

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("FY 2024 Results:")
print("=" * 80)
fy_2024_idx = fiscal_years.index(2024)
actual_2024 = actual_balance[fy_2024_idx]
structural_2024 = structural_balance[fy_2024_idx]
gap_2024 = abs(actual_2024 - structural_2024)

print(f"Actual balance FY 2024: {actual_2024:,.0f} million")
print(f"Structural balance FY 2024: {structural_2024:,.0f} million")
print(f"Absolute gap: {gap_2024:,.0f} million")

# Round to nearest whole number
actual_2024_rounded = round(actual_2024)
structural_2024_rounded = round(structural_2024)
gap_2024_rounded = round(gap_2024)

print(f"\nRounded values:")
print(f"[{actual_2024_rounded}, {structural_2024_rounded}, {gap_2024_rounded}]")
EOF
